audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are copy-paste bleed (tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles); breakdown.cooldowns has no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Contaminate (E) is 12/11/10/9/8s and is the real burst threat on stacked Deadly Venom; Ambush (Q) resets to a flat 16s cooldown whenever a Deadly-Venom-stacked champion dies, and Spray and Pray (R) is a flat 90s.

edits.before: Q the contact both ways, W-bounce the duo, walk — the trade taxed two people and refunded your mana bar.
edits.after: Bait his Venom Cask or Contaminate burst, then Spell Shield it — a blocked cast heals and speeds you clear.

edits.before: Spending E on chip damage and eating the engage it existed to eat — the shield is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Chasing a kill while stacked with Deadly Venom feeds his 12-8s Contaminate reset — clear the stacks, not the kill.

edits.before: - Twitch Ambush (Stealth): matchup-defining — The stealth approach starts every Twitch fight — sweep the flanks and track the disappearance. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Spell Shield for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Ambush is a flat 16s stealth reset on a Deadly-Venom kill — sweep wards, engage only on its downtime. - Contaminate (E) is 12-8s: save Spell Shield for it, not chip poke. - Spray and Pray (R) is a flat 90s piercing burst.
